title: Samsung reportedly to make Starlink chips at Austin fab, deepening space push
html:
Samsung will reportedly begin making Starlink chips at its Austin, Texas, fab. The chipmaker plans to use its Texas facilities to pursue a two-track semiconductor strategy, set up production near target markets, and push into the satellite sector.

Credit: AFP
